Traffic nitrogen dioxide.requires: vehicle exhaust in a street canyon
Traffic nitrogen dioxide.provides: concentrations highest beside the kerb, falling away within tens of metres, weekday peaks

Secondary particulate.provides: uniform concentrations across a whole city, no local source to control

Wood smoke from domestic heating.provides: evening and overnight peaks, worst in cold still weather, residential rather than roadside

Industrial plume grounding.requires: a stack plume brought to the surface
Industrial plume grounding.provides: a narrow downwind sector, episodic and short, a single identifiable operator

Temperature inversion.requires: a stable layer trapping air near the ground
Temperature inversion.provides: no vertical dispersion, accumulation over days

Strong wind.provides: dilution of everything local, possible import from elsewhere

Stagnant high pressure.requires: light winds over a wide area
Stagnant high pressure.provides: regional accumulation, no direction to the transport

Heavy rain.provides: removal of particulate, little effect on gaseous nitrogen dioxide

Traffic restriction by number plate.provides: reduction of vehicle emissions within a day, no effect on any other source

Solid fuel burning ban.provides: reduction of domestic smoke, compliance difficult to verify indoors

Industrial abatement order.requires: a permit condition and a named operator
Industrial abatement order.provides: reduction at one stack, no effect on diffuse sources

Public health advisory only.provides: behaviour change by vulnerable people, no reduction in concentration at all

Short exceedance.requires: standards breached for a day or two
Short exceedance.provides: reporting obligation, no lasting health signal

Prolonged episode with excess mortality.requires: high concentrations sustained for a week
